description: Unit tests for TlsrptRecorder. Test cases: record_failure for one domain produces correct failure record struct; multiple failures for same domain accumulate correctly; multiple domains tracked independently; all 11 TlsrptFailureType variants representable and serializable; serialized output matches RFC 8460 §4.3 JSON field names (failure-type as kebab-case string). Oracle: hand-written expected JSON per RFC 8460; do not use the serializer as its own oracle.
title: Tests: TLSRPT failure record accumulator
